meta.what: Pub/sub performance baseline: derived from Reticle's VOD scan usage log (<store>/notes/usage.jsonl, version scan-usage-1). Aggregate timings only.

definitions.readers_s: sum of feed + finish over the record's readers
definitions.pass_overlap_s: max(source, readers + other): source on its own worker, consumer unchanged
definitions.pass_parallel_s: max(source, slowest reader + other): readers also run concurrently
definitions.gain_*_frac_wall: (pass - bound) / wall; an upper bound that assumes free cores
definitions.decoded_fps_upper: manifest frame_count / pass; decode may stop at the last span end
definitions.concurrent_records: other usage records whose run interval overlaps this one's
definitions.overlap_frac: summed overlap with other recorded scans / wall (about the extra scans running)
definitions.after_nvdec_commit: recorded after commit 8002303 (NVDEC decode); an inference, the record names no backend
definitions.heaviest_buckets: feed-call counts per bucket, upper bounds in ms: 0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 50, 100, open
definitions.composite: a fused scan estimated from SEPARATE single-reader records: decode = the roi_cache:minimap video record's source time; each reader = its lowest recorded feed + finish. Not a measured scan; readers with no record are absent.
definitions.composite_core_plus_minimap: core plus minimap, on the sessions with a minimap record
